g.text: Title: 3T MRI Receive Coil - 123.26 MHz target

g.desc: Title: 3T MRI Receive Coil - 123.26 MHz target

g.text: Bench prototype: geometry / SMA / substrate require lab confirmation

g.desc: Bench prototype: geometry / SMA / substrate require lab confirmation

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: No transmit detuning, preamplifier protection or scanner interface is included. Bench prototype only.

g.desc: No transmit detuning, preamplifier protection or scanner interface is included. Bench prototype only.

g.text: they are not a lumped RF simulation model.

g.desc: they are not a lumped RF simulation model.

g.text: Matching topology is a proposed implementation. Confirm it and the supplied SMA before manufacturing.

g.desc: Matching topology is a proposed implementation. Confirm it and the supplied SMA before manufacturing.

g.text: Board/substrate assumption: nominal 1.6 mm FR4; no ground plane under the loop; SMA model is a candidate.

g.desc: Board/substrate assumption: nominal 1.6 mm FR4; no ground plane under the loop; SMA model is a candidate.

g.text: 75 mm OUTER copper diameter; trace centreline 70 mm; outer 75 mm; inner 65 mm; 5 mm trace; 35 um front copper.

g.desc: 75 mm OUTER copper diameter; trace centreline 70 mm; outer 75 mm; inner 65 mm; 5 mm trace; 35 um front copper.

g.text: Target: 123.26 MHz under the prescribed load. S11 < -20 dB is a measured acceptance target, not a CAD result.

g.desc: Target: 123.26 MHz under the prescribed load. S11 < -20 dB is a measured acceptance target, not a CAD result.

g.text: 5 pF is NOT a final resonant design value. Distributed values may also need increasing during tuning.

g.desc: 5 pF is NOT a final resonant design value. Distributed values may also need increasing during tuning.

g.text: C1-C3: 1210 (3.2 x 2.5 mm), starting value 5 pF per handout. C4: 1210, provisional 5 pF start.

g.desc: C1-C3: 1210 (3.2 x 2.5 mm), starting value 5 pF per handout. C4: 1210, provisional 5 pF start.

g.text: Copper arcs provide the loop inductance.

g.desc: Copper arcs provide the loop inductance.

g.text: C1, C2 and C3 lie 120 deg apart on the physical loop.

g.desc: C1, C2 and C3 lie 120 deg apart on the physical loop.
